subject: Pilot timing and resource alignment — quick decision?
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana@hightower.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot timing and resource alignment — quick decision?

Hi Dana — great conversation today, thank you for taking the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned:

Summary from our call:
- Goal: 4-week POC to validate latency and cost for real-time analytics queries against 10k monthly active users.
- Success metric: 95th percentile < 200ms for 512-token inference and cost per 1k requests under $X (TBD).
- Primary contacts: you (product), + procurement (unnamed), and Mateo (me) for technical coordination.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) I’ll send the POC outline & SOW draft (attached) — can you confirm stakeholders and a target start week?
2) You loop in procurement for initial T&Cs and estimated budget window.
3) We provision a test GPU node and share access by week 1 of the pilot.

Attachments:
- hightower-poc-outline.pdf (PDF, 48KB) — POC scope and data needs
- hightower-sow-v1.docx (DOCX, 12KB) — non-final SOW template

Question for you: are you still targeting a June kickoff? If so, we have a couple of short slots the week of June 7 we can hold while procurement reviews terms. If June is optimistic, let me know preferred timing and I’ll rework resource hold.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM inference

From: Dana Liu <dana@hightower.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timing and resource alignment — quick decision?

Thanks Mateo — that recap looks right. I’ll share the POC outline with our product lead and procurement today. Procurement has a backlog but they said they could prioritize this if we confirm timing. I expect we’ll know more by next Wednesday (May 18).

—Dana
Dana Liu
Head of Product, Hightower Analytics
dana@hightower.ai

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana@hightower.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timing and resource alignment — quick decision?

Hi Dana — looping back per your note last week. Quick check-in: any update from procurement or product on the proposed June window?

If helpful, we can:
- Push the kickoff to mid-June without a gap in support, or
- Hold a 30-minute procurement + legal sync (we’ve found that clears questions faster), or
- Pause and I’ll reassign the resource hold if your team prefers to revisit later.

For reference, link to the deal and SOW in our system: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HTW-2027-0543

I don’t want to be a pest — just trying to keep your calendar and our capacity coordinated. If you want me to schedule a procurement sync, I can send a 30-min invite.

Thanks,
Mateo

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana@hightower.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question — wrap or reassign?

Hi Dana — hope you’re well. I haven’t heard back after the procurement check — wanted to ask a direct question so I can manage internal capacity: would you like me to keep the June window tentatively reserved, or should I close this file and free up the POC slot for other customers?

If you’re still interested but procurement timing is the blocker, say the word and I’ll hold a single slot into the week of June 7 for two more weeks. If this isn’t a priority right now, no problem — I’ll close the deal record and we can reopen when you’re ready.

No pressure either way; I just want to be respectful of your calendar and our engineering availability. If you prefer, reply with a yes/no or I can mark this as closed and reconnect in Q3.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
